description: Turn one JSON Schema into OpenAI, Anthropic, and MCP tool definitions with the same name and description. It rewrites the envelope only. It does not validate that the schema is a good tool description.

description.description: What the tool does, copied into every format. Example: "Get the current weather for a city."
examples: Get the current weather for a city.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the arguments. Example: {"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}.

name: convert_schema
title: Convert a tool schema
